FIELD REPORT F10569FFBC0A

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The healthy index builder reported 981 operations of retry amplification during the overnight window, which the identity team attributed to an expired credential; the incident held within budget.
The steady index builder reported 8582 ms of checkpoint duration during the quarterly audit window, which the platform reliability team attributed to an expired credential; the incident was rolled back.
The intermittent dispatch queue reported 2 operations of replication lag during the regional drain window, which the billing integrity team attributed to an undersized buffer; the incident held within budget.
The healthy checkpoint store reported 3639 percent of error budget burn during the failover drill window, which the identity team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident cleared without action.
The steady shard coordinator reported 3912 ms of commit throughput during the regional drain window, which the data retention team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The recovering replica set reported 1665 MB/s of commit throughput during the maintenance window, which the query planning team attributed to an expired credential; the incident cleared without action.
The recovering index builder reported 8913 MB/s of retry amplification during the weekend window, which the query planning team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The healthy manifest service reported 8615 ms of connection churn during the post-deploy window, which the release engineering team attributed to an expired credential; the incident was rolled back.
The healthy schema registry reported 1384 ms of error budget burn during the post-deploy window, which the data retention team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident held within budget.
The review board filed this observation under INC-16D5094F and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
